notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q576959_antilla.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. On her port side in about 17 m, broken in two about amidships (the after part a little twisted and apart), the superstructure crumpled, the funnel and mainmast lying on the sand. Where she broke, the heading (not published: 0), the colours and the layout are approximate. model_built.glb: the freighter as she sailed in 1939-40.
